'''Hela Brandes''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who served in the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council]] as [[Music Advisor]]<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref> under [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]. In [[32 BBY]], Brandes was present when [[Senator]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] contacted the Council only to lose communication. [[Governor]] [[Sio Bibble]] thought that there would be an [[Invasion of Naboo|invasion]] by the [[Trade Federation]] from [[Naboo]]. Amidala refused to take any action that would lead the [[planet]] to war. The invasion did happen and the rest of the Naboo was captured. But later, the [[Monarch of Naboo|queen]] [[Battle of Naboo|freed]] her [[Homeworld|home planet]] and all of Naboo celebrated. She wore a draped [[Color|purple]] [[Clothing|dress]].<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Hela Brandes was portrayed by an uncredited actress in the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" />
